integrity: Mathematical proof and accompanying executable calculations supplied. No claim of independent validation or exhaustive published-literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: Uniform-stationary discrete-time symmetric nonnegative stochastic kernels supported on a cone over the crown graph, for each integer m at least 4; not a fixed-time mixing-time or nonreversible optimization theorem. Finite scripts support, rather than replace, the infinite-family proof. Originality may be limited by unindexed prior work.
title: Unique fastest mixing on cones over crown graphs
